## About
DTS Drive Train Specialists is a retail and online store on Groesbeck Hwy in Warren, Michigan. We carry a full line of drivetrain parts and components from Dana, Spicer, Timken, Richmond Gear, Moser, Eaton, Auburn Gear, Yukon Gear & Axle, Precision Gear and others.
Our shelves cover a lot of ground: ring and pinion sets, posi and limited slip units, Detroit Lockers, air lockers, bearing and install kits, axle shafts, yokes, seals and drive shafts, for Chrysler and Dodge, Ford, GM, Jeep, Toyota, Corvette and more.
Customers have rated us 4.5 on Google across 160 reviews. If you are working on a differential or driveline, come talk it through with us.

## Services
- Ring and pinion sets and parts: Dana ring and pinion sets and the parts that go with them.
- Limited slip and posi traction units: Limited slip and posi traction units to add traction to your axle.
- Jeep regearing: One reviewer called DTS the shop to use when regearing a Jeep.
- Drive shaft installs: One customer brought his Jeep in for an upgraded drive shaft install and said the work was quick.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I order parts online?
A: Yes. DTS runs both a retail store in Warren and an online store.

Q: Do you have a toll free number?
A: Yes, you can reach us toll free at (800) 521-0628.
